items.title: Archer Aviation Just Dropped 15% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysArcher Aviation shares have fallen 15% in the past month, and rival Joby Aviation fell even further as investors sold speculative tech stocks. Most of Archer’s own news was good, from a Barclays upgrade and a partial court win against Joby to new air-taxi plans in Texas and Italy.

items.title: Why Is Boeing (BA) Pushing Deeper Into Cargo And Airline Data Tools?
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) has agreed with Iceland based lessor Icelease to convert 767-300 passenger aircraft into dedicated freighters. The two sides plan a multi aircraft conversion program that feeds additional 767-300 freighters into the air cargo market. Boeing also introduced Dataliner, an AI powered data intelligence platform for airline customers, developed in partnership with Microsoft.
